payload.title: recheck_subject hands the fetched supergraph to the scan only when no commit touching any path of the supergraph workflow separates HEAD from the merge, and that path set includes the FE sources the class's own fixes edit, so a fixed graphql_operation_drift finding is judged unverifiable and left open whenever any later FE commit has merged.
evidence: tools/aria-poc/seed_drift_findings.py:432-439 (_schema_commit uses the workflow's whole push paths filter)
tools/aria-poc/seed_drift_findings.py:480-484 (exact requires merged_schema equal to HEAD's schema commit, otherwise no supergraph reaches the scan)
.github/workflows/apollo-supergraph-validate.yml:30-37 (the push paths include web/**/*.ts, web/**/*.tsx, mcp/**/*.ts and the owner's files)
tools/aria-poc/fetch_supergraph.py:55-59 (schema_commit runs git log over all push paths)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/finding_closure.py:275-291 (unverifiable five times for one reason ends as closure_unverifiable_exhausted with the finding left open)
payload.rule_violated: A check that decides closure should vary only with what can change its answer: an FE-only commit leaves the composed supergraph unchanged but makes the artifact non-exact.
payload.notes: A graphql_operation_drift fix is an FE edit by definition, so its merge is exact only while it is the newest commit touching web/ or mcp/. git log --first-parent shows six merges touching web/ or mcp/ in the eight days before the revision; once one lands before the cycle's recheck, the owner is not run (supergraph_not_given), the verdict is unverifiable, and after five tries the fixed finding stays open permanently. The direction is safe (never a false close); the cost is findings that cannot close. Close condition: Compute exactness from the supergraph's own inputs (the subgraph and composition paths without the FE globs and the gate's files) and add a recheck test in which an FE-only commit follows the fixing merge and the verdict is still absent. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 5). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
